prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Beijing for work, and I remember scrolling through car rental options there just to compare prices.
And earlier in 2025 I had a quick stop in Chengdu—at the time I was also checking what parking situations were like around the city center.
For that Beijing rental, the one we ended up with was a Volkswagen Lavida, and the pickup date on the paperwork was 2025-05-27.
It was set up for 9 days, and the renter name on the contract was Zhang Wei—my colleague handled all that back then.
In Chengdu we parked at Chunxi Road IFS Parking; the slot started at 2025-03-04 09:00 for 2 hours, and the details they used were plate 沪B67890 with the phone 13892862812.
